policy.training_rule: Values not marked measured or design must be randomized or revalidated before real-hardware deployment.

camera.calibration.source: camera calibration artifact from the hardware reference project

camera.effective_capture_rate.source: working TAG camera publisher comment for locked 8 ms exposure

camera.occlusion_grace.source: working TAG TCP environment default for configured occlusion regions

policy.effective_step_rate.source: working TAG environment 35 FPS warning threshold; synchronous TCP rate varies

hiwonder.policy_command_scale.source: working TAG Dreamer TCP environment default

hiwonder.effective_bridge_command_limit.source: working TAG TCP bridge executable default; lower than its README

insert.mounting_interface.source: 259 x 229 mm footprint is physically confirmed, but thickness and retention geometry remain unmeasured; blocks final-fit STL

insert.confirmed_fit_footprint.source: user-confirmed fit in the Sterling swappable-board platform on 2026-07-23

actuator.total_delay.source: median pure-delay fit from source-timestamped repeated +/-80 step runs on 2026-07-27

actuator.response_time_constant.source: median first-order 10-to-90 percent fit from source-timestamped repeated +/-80 step runs on 2026-07-27

actuator.local_positive_angle_map.source: rows alpha/beta, columns motor 1/2; median local response at +80 across three repetitions on 2026-07-27

actuator.local_negative_angle_map.source: rows alpha/beta, columns motor 1/2; median local response at -80 across three repetitions on 2026-07-27

actuator.local_stiction_command.source: bounded prior from gradual sweeps and repeated steps on 2026-07-27; positive motor 2 and negative motor 1 were directionally ambiguous at 40 and clear at 80

ball.floor_sliding_friction.source: broad untreated FDM PLA versus steel-marble prior in assumed_dynamics.json; pending physical inclined-plane or trajectory fit on the actual print

ball.torsional_friction_length.source: broad untreated FDM PLA MuJoCo 6D-contact prior in assumed_dynamics.json; pending physical spin-decay fit

ball.rolling_resistance_coefficient.source: log-scale untreated FDM PLA and hard-ball rolling prior; converted to MuJoCo rolling-friction length using the measured 0.006 m radius

ball.rolling_friction_length.source: rolling resistance coefficient multiplied by the measured 0.006 m ball radius

ball.linear_damping.source: broad effective velocity-damping prior for an untreated FDM PLA surface; pending quality-gated free-roll fit

ball.wall_restitution.source: broad low-speed steel-marble versus FDM PLA wall prior in assumed_dynamics.json; pending controlled wall-impact fit

planner.safety_margin.source: configurable planning prior for print and estimation error
